formulas.ascii: Pieces of the pipeline, not the whole procedure: core distance = distance to the minimumSamples-th nearest point (the point counts as its own first neighbour); mutual reachability d_mr(a, b) = max(core(a), core(b), d(a,b)). Without times, d is planar Euclidean distance. With relative times, d(a,b) = sqrt(dx² + dy² + (timeScale * dt)²), with subtraction before scaling and no hard temporal cutoff; nonfinite times are noise. The per-frame scale is nonnegative and converts temporal units to spatial units; temporalContext declares the relative-time encoding without unit conversion; the minimum spanning tree over d_mr gives the single-linkage dendrogram, which is condensed to clusters of at least minimumClusterSize points. Stability S(C) = sum over points p of C of (lambda_p - lambda_birth(C)) with lambda = 1 / distance. Excess-of-mass selection keeps a cluster when its stability exceeds the summed stability of its selected descendants; every other point is noise (0xffffffff).
